title: PAIR OF ART DECO HANGING LI...
reason: Pair of 1930s style chrome and opal glass Art Deco ceiling lights, a sought-after style; likely $150-350 for the pair (my estimate), subject to originality and completeness.
findings: Two photos show chrome multi-arm ceiling fittings with stepped (ziggurat) opal milk glass shades, lying on a table. I count about seven shades across the photos (a pair of three-arm fittings would carry six, so one extra shade or a four-arm fitting is in the mix), two central chrome hubs (one pear-shaped with scroll ornaments, one spherical), two loose bell-shaped ceiling canopies, two loose chrome rods, a string tag, and loose or cut wires (one old cloth-covered flex and one modern coloured wire end). The look is 1930s Art Deco, which supports the title, but the very bright chrome could mean re-plating or a later copy. No maker's mark, label or stamp seen on the fittings or shades. A search snippet seen on 19/10/2026 (page not opened) showed an Australian asking price of AU$350 or best offer for a single original Art Deco 3-arm milk glass ceiling light (https://www.ebay.com.au/shop/art-deco-ceiling-light?_nkw=art+deco+ceiling+light); asking price, not a sale.
condition: Chrome looks bright with no visible pitting or rust and the opal shades look unchipped in the photos; wiring is disconnected with bare ends so both fittings need rewiring and electrical certification; parts are unassembled.
rescore_note: Pair of 1930s style chrome multi-arm fittings with stepped opal shades, a strong Deco look and a spare shade, but unmarked, unwired, in parts and with some risk of re-plating or later copies; my estimate about $250 to $400 for the pair (no live comps).
